integrity: The proof is symbolic and self-contained. The cardinal count, heredity under changing maxima, exact restriction equivalence, coordinate isometry, and norm-one projections were checked directly. No computational experiment or external certificate is used as proof.
limitations: No necessity of the cardinal hypothesis is claimed, and the result does not prove the full implication from existence of an arbitrary universal hypergraph. The new construction gives exact hereditary universality directly under the explicit cardinal bound. General universal-structure literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact hereditary universality at cardinal \(\kappa\)
